dedupe_keys.name: bdset bds ppp b2b augmentation signals and products

description: BDSet publishes BeiDou PPP-B2b augmentation signals collected in Wuhan, China, and successive processing products for positioning, navigation and timing applications. The Wuhan University research team provides raw receiver-chip messages, standardised augmentation messages, decoded state-space corrections and recovered precise products. Science Data Bank marks version 2 as a public dataset under CC BY 4.0 with free access. Its description states continuous updates from 1 January 2023 and coverage through 31 December 2025. The separate coverage widget displays endpoints one day earlier, so the exact boundary requires clarification before time-sensitive use. The public repository reports 1,217 files and 38.62 GB, but the inspected view does not enumerate file formats or a single common sample interval across processing levels. The resource can benchmark positioning corrections, availability and timing components in GNSS-dependent infrastructure simulations, alongside tools such as platform-gnss-sdr. A caveat is that reception at one location does not establish worldwide service availability. The describing article reports a different total size, and no archive transfer or software execution was attempted.
